title: JDE Platform Manager
description:
### **Why join Stryker?**

Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award-winning culture.  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

### **Job description**

We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine!
  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.  

**What You Will Do:**
---------------------

  

* Own and execute the strategic roadmap for the **JD Edwards (JDE) platform**, driving upgrades, modernization initiatives, and long-term platform sustainability.
* Lead the administration and lifecycle management of JDE environments, ensuring seamless operations across development, testing, production, and disaster recovery landscapes.
* Establish and enforce platform governance, standards, and best practices for deployments, change management, access controls, monitoring, and operational excellence.
* Partner with business leaders, application teams, infrastructure, cybersecurity, quality, and compliance stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable JDE solutions.
* Oversee the successful planning and execution of platform enhancements, releases, upgrades, and maintenance activities while ensuring adherence to governance and quality standards.
* Drive platform stability and performance through proactive monitoring, optimization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Manage JDE operational components including integrations, batch processing, security roles, menu structures, scheduler management, and application configuration.
* Govern vendor and managed service provider relationships, ensuring high-quality service delivery, effective issue resolution, and achievement of performance commitments.
* Collaborate with global stakeholders to prioritize demand, assess business impact, manage dependencies, and align release activities with organizational objectives.
* Ensure audit readiness and regulatory compliance by maintaining robust controls, documentation, traceability, and support for SOX, GxP, privacy, security, and financial requirements.

**What you will need:**
-----------------------

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, Business Technology, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
* 10+ years of experience in enterprise IT, ERP platforms, application operations, infrastructure management, or related technology environments.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience administering, supporting, or leading **JD Edwards EnterpriseOne (JDE E1)** in a complex production environment.
* Proven experience leading technical teams, managed service providers, vendors, or cross-functional delivery teams to successfully execute platform initiatives.
* Strong expertise in JDE platform administration, with hands-on experience across areas such as CNC administration, environment management, package builds, security, tools releases, ESUs, integrations, scheduling, and production support.
* Demonstrated success delivering JDE upgrades, tools releases, environment builds, production deployments, or major ERP platform transformation initiatives.
* Experience operating within regulated or controlled environments, including SOX, GxP, ITGC, cybersecurity, privacy, audit, or validated change management frameworks.
* Strong vendor and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to govern service delivery, manage escalations, drive accountability, and influence outcomes across global teams.
* Expertise in developing operational documentation, runbooks, implementation plans, support procedures, and governance artifacts while effectively communicating platform risks, health, and recommendations to leadership.
* Relevant certifications in JD Edwards, Oracle, ITIL, project management, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, infrastructure, or quality/compliance disciplines are highly desirable.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Manager, Smart Acquirer Services (SAS) Commercial Program Management
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Manager, Smart Acquirer Services (SAS) Commercial Program ManagementManager, Smart Acquirer Services (SAS) Program Management  
About Mastercard  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments sector. We power payments and provide products and services for individuals and industries around the world. Our people, technology, data and brand provide the capabilities that drive our success. We believe in connecting people to priceless possibilities.  
  
Overview  
Mastercard’s Global Acceptance & Merchant Solutions team is transforming the acquiring ecosystem through Smart Acquirer Services (SAS), a strategic initiative designed to deliver a single access point to Mastercard acceptance, security, performance optimization and innovation capabilities through Merchant Cloud. SAS is being commercialized globally across multiple regions and markets, requiring a scalable operating model, governance framework, commercialization playbooks and market rollout strategy.''  
  
The Manager, Smart Acquirer Services Program Management will serve as the central program lead responsible for driving end-to-end execution of the SAS initiative globally. This individual will act as the connective tissue across Product, Finance, Legal, Regional Teams, Controllers, Services, Implementation, Customer Delivery and Commercialization teams to ensure successful launch and scale of SAS across priority markets.  
This role requires a highly organized commercial PMO leader capable of managing complex global initiatives, driving accountability across workstreams, building scalable playbooks and ensuring market readiness from business case through launch and adoption.  
  
Role
  
  
As Manager, SAS Program Management, you will be responsible for establishing and operating the global program office supporting Smart Acquirer Services.  
You will own the planning, governance, execution and reporting framework required to successfully launch and scale SAS across multiple markets and regions.  

* Global Program Leadership: Establish and manage the overall SAS program governance model, including executive steering committees, working groups, weekly program reviews, milestones, dependencies, risk registers and escalation paths.
* Country Commercialization Playbooks: Build and maintain a repeatable SAS commercialization framework that can be deployed market by market, starting with priority markets including South Africa, Thailand, Vietnam, Philippines, Georgia and Mauritius.
* Market Qualification & Readiness: Coordinate revenue opportunity assessments, business case development and readiness reviews across commercial opportunity, competitive landscape, regulatory considerations, sponsorship, stakeholder alignment and launch qualification criteria.
* Product & Bundle Governance: Coordinate global decisions regarding SAS bundle composition, product inclusion and exclusion governance, regional product requirements, rollout sequencing and alignment with the product roadmap.
* Business Cases, Pricing & Finance: Partner with Finance, Controllers and Pricing teams to establish market business cases, revenue allocation methodologies, RPIC approvals and tracking of projected and realized revenue impact by market.
* Commercialization & Go-to-Market Execution: Coordinate regional commercialization workstreams, develop market-level rollout plans, drive acquirer prioritization, customer engagement planning, roadshows, enablement programs and launch readiness activities.
* Implementation & Customer Delivery: Partner with implementation and delivery teams to establish standardized onboarding processes for acquirer onboarding, Merchant Cloud provisioning, certification, customer acceptance testing and go-live readiness reviews.
* Launch Governance & Adoption: Manage launch approval processes and decision gates, define adoption KPIs and success metrics, build executive dashboards and track adoption, activation and revenue realization across markets.

Success Metrics  

* Number of markets launched on schedule.
* Revenue impact delivered versus business case.
* Country readiness and approval cycle times.
* Acquirer onboarding and adoption rates.
* Commercialization milestone attainment.
* Program governance effectiveness.
* Executive stakeholder satisfaction.
* Program risk mitigation and issue resolution.

All About You  

* Proven experience leading complex global programs, PMOs or strategic transformations.
* Strong background in payments, acquiring, acceptance, gateways or value-added services.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams across Product, Finance, Legal, Sales, Services, Operations, Implementation and Customer Delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to manage executive stakeholders and influence without authority.
* Exceptional program management, governance and organizational skills.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience building business cases, financial models and market launch plans.
* Ability to drive complex initiatives from concept through commercialization, launch and adoption.
* Experience managing multiple markets and regions simultaneously.
* Comfortable operating in a highly matrixed global organization.
* Strong communications and executive presentation skills.
* Analytical, structured and data-driven.
* PMP, MBA or equivalent program management experience preferred.
* English fluency required.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Manager, TSG Data Engineering
description:
COMPANY PROFILE
  
  
Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.
  
  
Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.
  
  
The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals - serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics - who support our offices globally. Our mantra of "shared innovation, seamless execution," underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.
  
  
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.
  
  
Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
  
  
This position works as a member of software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal data. Team members work collaboratively to design, build and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain’s global users and supporting key business initiatives.
  
  
WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM
  
  
This position works as a member of Bain’s internal Software Development group directly supervising and supporting the Data engineers on a team. Individuals in this role would also be responsible for defining the on-going technical roadmap for the team and influencing the choice of technologies and frameworks implemented by the engineers.
  
  
WHAT YOU’LL DO
  
  
Technical Delivery (50%)
  

* Lead a scrum team developing and updating applications
* Lead the planning, testing and implementation of all production releases. Coordinate production releases between scrum teams across the product. Work with System Architect, Data Architect and engineering team members for the configuration and implementation of DevOps and Continues Integration.
* Encourage DevOps mindset within the engineering team and facilitates lean production, continuous integration and continuous deployment while working with the System Architect and engineering team members.
* Support the team in the evaluation and selection process of the 3rd part components/libraries/ tools together with the Systems Architect and Data Architect.
* Provide ongoing support for applications already in use. This includes problem diagnosis and resolution, ad hoc reporting support and database administration.
* Provide frequent updates regarding development issues to the TSG leadership and other groups as appropriate.
* Participate in product level Steering Committee meetings as appropriate.
* Provide technical leadership and facilitate cross-team communication across multiple product scrum teams.
* Ensure the proposed technical approaches meet the functional requirements and are in coordination with similar activities across the other product scrum teams. Provide guidance to the scrum team determining the need for new technologies based on the product backlog.

Team management (25%)
  

* Manage and supervise between 3-6 direct reports within the development team. These individuals are typically working on the team they directly support. Responsible for the individuals’ PD and career development.
* Participate in hiring of developers/ engineering team members.
* Support individual team members and provide technical input and mentorship to help the team deliver current work in the sprint. Assess and help them improve their engineering practices.
* Coach teams and individuals on their understanding of Agile methodologies and Agile practices improving their interactions and ensuring they have the right process and tools for their success.
* Promote practices which help with incremental delivery and continuous integration and remove any blockers from achieving incremental delivery.
* Work with the Scrum Master to identify teaching and learning opportunities for their direct reports and help the scrum team members to be more T-Shaped.

Strategy, planning and technology leadership (25%)
  

* Support the Scrum Master in improving delivery metrics like velocity, responsiveness, predictability, quality, etc.
* Advise business and technology partners on technology solutions leveraging emerging technologies and on mitigation of disruption risk.
* Prepare and maintain the long-term technology roadmap for the product based on the product vision. Work with the Product Owner, System Architect, Data Architect and engineering team members for its implementation.

ABOUT YOU
  

* Experience in software development including work on all aspects of the development life cycle.
* Solid understanding of Agile Methodology with experience in managing sprints/ scrums and user stories while using tools such as VSTS, Jira, etc.
* Experience architecting applications and working on enterprise-wide systems.
* Experience leading technical teams on small to medium size projects.
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions.
* Strong communication, time management and customer service skills.
* High performance and standards as demonstrated by academic or previous job experience.

**Data Engineering - Technical skills:**  

* Languages: SQL, PySpark, Python, Scala
* Data Storage & Analytics: Delta Lake, Unity catalog, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL, Azure Data Lake, Blob Storage, etc.
* ETL Tools: Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory
* Cloud-based data warehouse and Lakehouse architectures on Microsoft Azure
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Azure Databricks, ADLS, ADF, Azure Logic app
* DevOps: Git, GitHub Actions, Terraform
* Visualization Tools: Tableau, Power BI, etc.

Experience
  

* 8-10 experience in software development including work on all aspects of the development life cycle.

title: Business Development Associate – Customer Success & Retention
description:
About Ultimutt Ultimutt is a premium at-home pet care and grooming service built around one simple promise — bringing trusted pet grooming to the pet parent's doorstep. We provide convenient, professional grooming and hygiene services delivered by trained professionals using vet-approved products and tools. We are building a customer-first brand where every interaction with a pet parent is an opportunity to build trust, create delight and drive long-term relationships.

Role Overview

We are looking for energetic and customer-focused Business Development Associates to join our Customer Success & Retention team. In this role, you will be responsible for connecting with existing and prospective customers over the phone, understanding their needs, introducing them to Ultimutt's services, driving appointment bookings and converting customers into recurring members. You will also act as an important voice of the customer by helping resolve customer concerns, supporting escalations and conducting customer research to identify opportunities to improve our products and services.

Key Responsibilities

1. Customer Calling & Appointment Conversion

● Make outbound calls to prospective and existing customers.

● Introduce customers to Ultimutt's at-home grooming and pet care services.

● Understand customer requirements, pet profiles and grooming needs.

● Recommend relevant services based on customer needs.

● Drive appointment bookings and follow up on leads and enquiries.

● Maintain regular follow-ups with customers who have not yet booked.

2. Membership & Retention

● Explain Ultimutt's membership plans, benefits and value proposition to customers.

● Drive membership sales and upgrades among existing customers.

● Identify opportunities for repeat bookings and increased customer engagement.

● Follow up with customers after service completion to encourage repeat usage.

● Build strong relationships with customers and improve customer retention.

3. Customer Success & Escalation Management

● Act as the first point of contact for customer queries and concerns.

● Understand customer complaints and coordinate with internal teams to resolve them.

● Follow up proactively until the customer's issue is closed.

● Ensure customers receive a positive experience even when there is a service issue.

● Escalate critical or unresolved issues to the Team Lead / Manager.

4. Customer Research & Feedback

● Conduct customer feedback calls and surveys as required.

● Speak to customers to understand their experience, preferences and pain points.

● Collect insights on service quality, pricing, membership, grooming experience and overall customer satisfaction.

● Share recurring customer feedback and actionable insights with the Team Lead / Manager.

● Support customer research initiatives and pilot programs when required.

5. CRM & Reporting

● Maintain accurate customer interaction records in the CRM.

● Update call outcomes, appointment status, membership status and customer feedback.

● Ensure timely follow-ups on all assigned customers.

● Track daily performance against calling, booking, conversion and retention targets.

● Prepare and share relevant customer insights and updates with the reporting manager.

Key Performance Indicators Performance will be measured across both business outcomes and customer experience, including:

● Number of customer calls and meaningful conversations

● Appointment bookings and conversion rate

● Membership sales and conversion

● Repeat booking / retention performance

● Customer issue resolution and turnaround time

● Customer satisfaction and feedback

● Follow-up adherence

● CRM data accuracy and process compliance

Who Are We Looking For?

● 1–3 years of experience in inside sales, telecalling, business development, customer success, customer retention or customer service.

● Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

● Comfortable speaking with customers over the phone.

● Strong persuasion and objection-handling abilities.

● Customer-first mindset with a strong sense of ownership.

● Ability to handle customer complaints calmly and professionally.

● Comfortable working with targets and performance metrics.

● Good follow-up discipline and attention to detail.

● Comfortable using CRM systems, spreadsheets and basic digital tools.

● Prior experience in pet care, D2C, consumer services, hospitality, beauty/wellness or other service businesses will be an advantage.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who can balance selling with serving. You should be comfortable picking up the phone, starting a conversation with a customer, understanding what they need, recommending the right Ultimutt service, closing an appointment or membership — and staying involved if the customer faces an issue. You should be empathetic, persuasive, proactive and target-oriented, with a genuine interest in creating great customer experiences.

What You Will Get

● Opportunity to work with a fast-growing premium pet care brand.

● High ownership and exposure to customer acquisition, retention and customer experience.

● Opportunity to directly influence business growth and customer satisfaction.

● Learning and growth opportunities within the Customer Success & Retention function.

● Performance-linked incentives based on business and customer success outcomes.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.  

  

The Business Services Team (BST) consists of various functional professionals, including our business management and operations team members, who work to ensure that BCG is running smoothly, efficiently, and productively.
  

Members of this team contribute directly to the success of our business through a number of roles, including executive and administrative assistants, visual service artists, receptionists, facilities staff, and the team leaders and office coordinators who manage these operations and business management jobs.  



  

  

What You'll Do


As an Administrative Assistant (AA), you will provide high\-quality administrative and operational support to multiple senior stakeholders across global regions, including APAC, EMESA, and the US. You will serve as a trusted business partner, enabling stakeholders to operate effectively by proactively managing day\-to\-day administrative priorities in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
  

  

At BCG, Administrative Assistants are integral members of the Business Services Team (BST). We encourage continuous learning and professional development, empowering AAs to build new capabilities and grow alongside the evolving needs of the business.
  

In this role, you will take ownership of complex calendars and schedules, anticipate stakeholder needs, coordinate activities across multiple times zones, and manage confidential information with professionalism, sound judgment, and discretion.
  

  

By providing seamless administrative support, you will help maximize stakeholder productivity and enable leaders to focus on strategic and value\-added priorities.
  

  

You will collaborate closely with Administrative Assistants and business support colleagues across BCG's global organization to ensure seamless coverage, knowledge sharing, and consistent service delivery. As business needs evolve, you may also provide backup support and undertake additional responsibilities assigned by your manager.

 **Executive \& Calendar Management**: Proactively manage complex calendars, prioritize competing demands, coordinate meetings across multiple global time zones, and optimize stakeholders' time through effective scheduling, planning, and coordination.

 **Stakeholder Partnership**: Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and cross\-functional teams by delivering responsive, reliable, and professional support while exercising sound judgment, confidentiality, and discretion in all interactions.

 **Travel \& Expense Management**: Coordinate end\-to\-end domestic and international travel, prepare and manage travel itineraries, process expense reports accurately and in a timely manner and proactively resolve travel\-related issues to ensure a seamless stakeholder experience.

 **Operational Support**: Deliver high\-quality administrative support through meeting and event coordination, preparation of business documents and presentations, maintenance of accurate records, and continuous process improvement. Collaborate closely with the Administrative Assistant community to ensure seamless coverage, knowledge sharing, and consistent service excellence.

  

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification.
* 4\+ years of professional experience in a multinational organization, professional services, or a similar fast\-paced environment.
* Experience supporting global stakeholders and managing competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment is an advantage.
* Prior experience in an administrative, executive support, or coordination role is preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

  

Additional info


You're Good At

* Thriving in a fast\-paced, dynamic, and service\-oriented environment while managing multiple priorities.
* Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders through professionalism, responsiveness, reliability, and a customer\-first mindset.
* Applying policies and guidelines with appropriate flexibility while upholding BCG's values and culture.
* Working effectively within a complex, matrixed, and global organization.
* Managing competing priorities with excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Handling sensitive and confidential information with discretion and integrity.
* Communicating effectively with stakeholders across cultures, geographies, and organizational levels.
* Collaborating across teams by sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues, and contributing to a positive, high\-performing team culture.

 **Key Competencies**

* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build effective relationships across all organizational levels.
* Excellent planning, organizational, and prioritization skills with strong attention to detail.
* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, reliability, and a strong commitment to delivering results.
* Demonstrates a proactive mindset by anticipating stakeholder needs, identifying opportunities for improvement, and delivering value\-added support.
* Strong customer service mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional stakeholder experiences.
* Ability to remain calm, adaptable, and resilient under pressure.
* Demonstrates sound judgment, professionalism, and the highest standards of ethics and confidentiality.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong collaboration and teamwork capabilities.
* Excellent time management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple competing deadlines while maintaining accuracy and quality.

  

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.


For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.


We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
